children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Manage stable identity, useful operator metadata, and image selection while understanding which values require replacement.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: An image override bypasses the template default. Pin it only for a tested exception with a rollback path.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: The GameServer name and UID anchor workload identity; template and version changes belong in their dedicated workflows.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: The server name cannot be edited from General settings.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Clone or create a replacement when infrastructure identity must change.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Move data only through a verified backup and restore plan.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Description is searchable operator context, not player-facing MOTD or an incident notebook.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Summarize purpose, owner, and lifecycle expectations briefly.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Update metadata when ownership or operational purpose changes.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Never include secrets, private addresses, or player data.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Leave the field blank to inherit the template; a tested repository and immutable tag or digest is an explicit exception.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Blank → inherit the installed template and selected version

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Pin → repository + immutable tag/digest; save one change

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Watch pull events, then verify game, files, ports, and backups

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
